products.title: Rotating Hinge Knee Prosthesis
products.description:
This product consists of a femoral condyle, tibial tray, tibial insert, long screws, intramedullary pins, winged sleeves, and fixation screws; the femoral condyle is assembled from femoral condyle components, intercondylar polyethylene liners, three-way sleeves, plastic sleeves, positioning screws, and fixation screws.

The femoral condyle components and tibial tray are made of cast cobalt-chromium-molybdenum alloy; three-way sleeves, positioning screws and long screws of forged cobalt-chromium-molybdenum alloy; tibial insert, intercondylar polyethylene liners and plastic sleeves of Type 2 UHMWPE; fixation screws and intramedullary pins of forged TC4 titanium alloy; winged sleeves of TC4ELI titanium alloy via electron beam melting. All components are gamma-ray sterilized with a 5-year sterile shelf life. Compatible with components of the same system from the enterprise, it is indicated for total knee arthroplasty and revision procedures.

Hip arthroplasty in osteoporotic or wide femoral canals (Dorr Type C)

sections.label: Features

Standard and lateralized (+5 mm offset) configurations

products.title: BC Cemented Femoral Stem

sections.label: Features
sections.html:
1. Collarless mirror finish: Eliminates shear stress risers and promotes hydrostatic cement pressurization.
  2. Balanced double taper: Transfers axial compressive forces without localized stress concentrations.
  3. High-strength Co-Cr-Mo material: Outstanding fatigue endurance under continuous cyclical walking loads.
  4. Straightforward revision extraction: Smooth surface devoid of undercuts simplifies future revision if required.
  5. Extensively documented clinical history: High long-term implant survival rates in mature patient populations.

products.description:
The BC (B-C1) cemented femoral stem is manufactured from forged Co-Cr-Mo alloy with a collarless surgical-grade ultra-high polish mirror finish.

Designed for implantation with acrylic bone cement, it distributes physiological loads evenly throughout the cement mantle. Its gentle taper facilitates hydrostatic settling that eliminates cement cracks, ensuring durable, long-term prosthetic fixation.
specs: Forged Co-Cr-Mo Alloy with collarless mirror-polished finish
Standard 12/14 taper for 28, 32, and 36 mm heads
Total and partial cemented hip arthroplasty

products.title: Delta Ceramic Femoral Head

sections.label: Features
sections.html:

  4. Superior biological wettability: Promotes continuous synovial fluid film for smooth hydrodynamic lubrication.
  5. Versatile neck offsets (-3.5 to +7 mm): Precise restoration of leg length discrepancy and soft tissue tension.

products.description:
The ceramic femoral head is manufactured from zirconia-toughened alumina matrix composite ceramic (Biolox Delta). This cutting-edge material combines the extraordinary hardness and wear resistance of alumina with the fracture toughness and crack-deflecting strength of zirconia.

Its nanoscale surface finish achieves the lowest coefficient of friction in joint arthroplasty, minimizing polyethylene wear and completely eliminating metal ion release.

Chemically inert, completely free of metal ion release
28 mm, 32 mm, and 36 mm with multiple neck offsets
Gamma Radiation / Ethylene Oxide (5-year sterile shelf life)

  5. Ideal for elderly cohorts: Delivers immediate joint stability permitting safe early weight-bearing.

products.description:

Designed for patients with compromised acetabular bone stock, osteoporosis, or severe dislocation risks, it delivers rigid cemented fixation combined with unmatched dual-mobility anti-dislocation kinematics.
specs: Co-Cr-Mo outer cup mirror-polished internally / VE-HXLPE mobile liner
Hip fractures in elderly patients and revisions in osteoporotic bone

products.title: Dual Mobility Cup Assembly (Screw Fixation)

  4. VE-HXLPE bearing liner: Antioxidant-stabilized polyethylene prevents oxidative degradation.

It combines immediate primary mechanical stability via iliac bone screws with the superior anti-dislocation protection intrinsic to dual-mobility kinematics. An implant of choice in revision procedures and complex primary surgeries with abductor deficiency.

Cementless biological press-fit supplemented with bone screws
Screw holes oriented into the safe iliac bone zone
Dual mobility with extended angular arc of motion (>140°)
Revisions for recurrent dislocation and abductor-deficient hips

products.title: Dual Mobility Cup with Metallic Insert

sections.label: Features

Modular dual-mobility cup with polished metal bearing sleeve
Complex revisions, recurrent dislocation, and modular reconstruction

3 apical holes with titanium sealing plugs included

products.title: Metallic Dual Mobility Bearing Liner

Metallic bearing liner for dual-mobility articulation
Mirror polish finish with roughness Ra < 0.05 µm
Primary and revision dual-mobility hip arthroplasty

Direct fixation with forged TC4 titanium bone screws
Reconstruction of Paprosky Type II and III acetabular defects

  4. Immense biocompatibility and inertia: Elicits zero inflammatory response and resists all in vivo biological corrosion.
  5. Rigid structural support: Restores acetabular architecture and securely supports the overlying cup.

The porous tantalum metal augment is a structural reconstructive implant fabricated from high-purity medical-grade tantalum via chemical vapor deposition (CVD) or additive manufacturing. Its biomimetic trabecular cellular structure features 75% to 85% porosity and a completely interconnected 400-600 µm pore size resembling native cancellous bone matrix.

Indicated for structural filling of major cavitary hip bone defects (Paprosky Types II and III), it provides the highest initial coefficient of friction in orthopedics and an elastic modulus matching host bone.

400 µm to 600 µm (optimal for accelerated osteogenesis)
Approximately 3 GPa (closely matches human cancellous bone)
Paprosky Type II and III cavitary and segmental acetabular defects
